name: Java 8+ API desugaring support
note: The Classpath Exception removes the copyleft effect of linking, so using this library does not oblige us to release the application source. The exception must be named alongside the GPL or the entry reads as a stronger obligation than it is.

name: Glide
note: Compound licence: BSD-2-Clause for Glide itself, Apache-2.0 for third_party/disklrucache, MIT for third_party/gif_decoder, plus two permissive grants in third_party/gif_encoder that have no SPDX identifier.

name: PhotoView
note: Published on JitPack under the original author coordinate; the canonical repository is Baseflow/PhotoView.

name: JSch (mwiede fork)
note: The POM declares three licences: BSD-3-Clause for JSch, BSD-3-Clause for the bundled JZlib, ISC for the bundled jBCrypt.

name: Play Feature Delivery
spdx: Play Core Software Development Kit Terms of Service

name: Play In-App Review
spdx: Play Core Software Development Kit Terms of Service

name: ZXing Core
note: Licence inherited from the zxing-parent POM; the core artifact declares no licences block of its own.

name: SMBJ
note: Apache-2.0 per the repository LICENSE_HEADER and the licences block of the 0.12.1 POM. The LGPL sometimes associated with SMB clients on Android belongs to jcifs-ng, a different library this project does not use.

name: Tesseract4Android
note: Bundles Tesseract OCR (Apache-2.0) and Leptonica (BSD-2-Clause) as native libraries.

name: epub4j
note: Apache-2.0 per the repository LICENSE and the 4.2 POM. The upstream epublib project this is forked from declares LGPL in its parent POM, which is why the two are sometimes conflated.

name: FFmpeg (custom Media3 decoder build)
note: Built from FFmpeg sources by scripts/builders/build-ffmpeg-dts.sh and shipped as app_v2/libs/fms-ffmpeg-dts.aar. Its configure invocation passes neither --enable-gpl nor --enable-nonfree and disables postproc, the GPL component, so the produced binary is LGPL-2.1-or-later.

name: Bouncy Castle Provider
note: Published as the "Bouncy Castle Licence"; the text is verbatim MIT with their copyright, so scanners report NOASSERTION and the identifier is set by hand.

name: NanoHTTPD
note: Licence inherited from the nanohttpd-project POM; the artifact declares no licences block of its own.
